data.title: CNBC Fed Survey: Majority Now Forecast At Least Two Rate Hikes Over Next Year
data.description:
According to CNBC, a majority of respondents to the CNBC Fed Survey now expect at least two Federal Reserve rate hikes over the next year, while 55% forecast more than one increase. That marks a sharp shift from last month, when 46% expected a hike ahead, and the share has risen to 86%.

The survey found that respondents now see inflation as broader than energy prices after Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh delivered a hawkish Jackson Hole speech, oil prices surged and inflation failed to cool. Most of the 29 respondents, including economists, fund managers and strategists, said the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed at least a month longer and that oil prices will stay elevated for more than six months. CPI forecasts rose for both 2026 and 2027, with the average forecast near 3.5% for this year and 2.85% in 2027.

The Fed is set to decide on rates Wednesday at the end of its two-day meeting. Despite the shift toward multiple hikes, respondents left the growth outlook little changed, with recession odds at an average 29% over the next 12 months, GDP seen around 2.25% this year and next, and unemployment expected near 4.25%. The S&P 500 is forecast to hold its current level through year-end and rise 8% to 8,274 next year.

data.title: DBS, OCBC and UOB Complete First Singapore Dollar Tokenized Deposit Payment on Swift Ledger
data.description: DBS, OCBC and UOB have completed a local Singapore dollar tokenized deposit payment on the Swift blockchain ledger, marking the first interbank tokenized deposit transaction among the three institutions. According to Odaily, the banks had previously completed cross-border transactions on Swift Ledger. After local interoperability was established, corporate clients can complete tokenized payments across institutions.

data.title: KRX After-Hours Trading Sees Heavy Volume, Volatility on First Day
data.description: According to The Korea Herald, volatility rose and price control mechanisms were triggered at a much higher level on the first day of after-hours trading on the Korea Exchange (KRX), the bourse operator said Tuesday. The KRX launched the session from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. Monday to boost global competitiveness and widen trading opportunities for investors. A total of 72.24 million shares worth 1.8 trillion won (US$1.3 billion) changed hands during the four-hour session, compared with some 905 million won in the previous benchmark period.

data.title: Bitcoin Needs $82,877 to Offset Expected Mining Difficulty Increase
data.description:
Bitcoin would need to rise to approximately $82,877 to offset a projected 4.6976% increase in mining difficulty. According to NS3.AI, the estimate is based on a BTC price of $79,158.

The next mining difficulty retarget is expected around 05:42 UTC on Sept. 19. A separate estimate projected a 5.26% increase.

data.title: Balancer Considers Phased Shutdown After v3 Exploit and $130 Million Losses
data.description:
Balancer is considering a phased shutdown after an exploit hit its v3 protocol and caused almost $130 million in losses. According to NS3.AI, Balancer Labs CEO Marcus Hardt proposed distributing the project's $9 million treasury to BAL holders.

The proposal would move all pools to withdrawal-only mode on October 30.

data.title: STOCKS | Wells Fargo Cuts S&P 500 Year-End Target to 7,700, Downgrades Tech to Neutral
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Wells Fargo cut its year-end target for the S&P 500 Index from 7,950 to 7,700, downgraded technology stocks to neutral from overweight, and upgraded healthcare stocks to overweight.

data.title: GM Unveils New In-Vehicle Infotainment System for Silverado and Sierra
data.description: According to CNBC, General Motors is rolling out a new in-vehicle information and entertainment software experience later this year, starting with its redesigned Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra pickup trucks. The automaker said the updated interface, controls and software are designed to offer smartphone-like convenience and customization, and it has reorganized its digital experience operations under design rather than software, led by former Apple and Google executive Sebastian Bauer. GM said the system will proactively surface relevant controls, add a major visual upgrade for Super Cruise by showing objects such as other vehicles and pedestrians on the driver cluster screen, and change how Apple CarPlay and Android Auto work by displaying them in part of the screen instead of taking over the full display. The company said the system is expected to expand across a broader portfolio of vehicles over an undisclosed period.

data.title: Oppenheimer Upgrades Etsy To Outperform, Sees 21% Upside
data.description: According to CNBC, Oppenheimer upgraded Etsy to outperform from perform and set a $90 price target on the online marketplace, implying 21% upside from Monday's close. Analyst Jason Helfstein said the move reflects expected benefits from AI search, product improvements, and stronger app engagement and conversion. Oppenheimer said consumers are relying less on Google Search for online shopping and are increasingly using AI tools for product discovery, based on a recent survey. Adobe Analytics data also showed that nearly half of U.S. consumers used AI for online shopping in June. Oppenheimer now forecasts a 5% increase in gross merchandise sales growth over the next two years, even as Etsy loses ground in the online handmade market. The firm also said its poll showed consumers have noticed improvements in Etsy's product listings and descriptions, which should make discovery easier and support more sales on the platform. Shares of Etsy have risen 24% year to date and gained 2% in premarket trading after the upgrade.

data.title: STOCKS | Zorlu Enerji Bond Poised for Record Drop After Adviser Hire
data.description:
Zorlu Enerji’s bond is set for its biggest decline on record after the Turkish energy company hired debt advisers, according to Bloomberg.

Weaker sales and a falling lira are straining the company’s ability to service its international debt.

data.title: China’s AI Export Boom Masks Weak Domestic Economy
data.description: China’s domestic economy remains stuck in the slow lane as an AI-driven export boom keeps shipments afloat, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: UK CPI, US Retail Sales Due As Markets Await Wednesday Data
data.description:
UK CPI and U.S. retail sales are among the key data releases due on Wednesday, according to ETNet.

In Asia, South Korea President Lee Jae-myung is chairing the Korea-Central Asia summit through the 17th. At 3:00 PM Hong Kong time, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen will deliver the State of the Union address. At 8:15 PM, European Central Bank Vice President Luis de Guindos will chair a policy panel at the 2026 ECB Annual Research Conference, followed by a keynote speech from ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone at 9:00 PM.

Japan will release August export and import data at 7:50 AM Hong Kong time, while the euro zone will publish July industrial production at 5:00 PM. The UK will report August CPI at 2:00 PM and July house price data at 4:30 PM. The U.S. will release August export and import prices at 8:30 PM, August retail sales at 8:30 PM, and the September NAHB housing market index at 10:00 PM.

In Hong Kong, companies due to report earnings on Thursday include Black Mountain Mining (00159), Evergrande Auto (00708) and Tianji Partners (02479).

data.title: Velocity Raises Another $10 Million From Visa, Circle and Ripple
data.description:
Velocity raised another $10 million from investors including Visa, Circle and Ripple, bringing its extended Series A to $48 million. According to NS3.AI, the London-based firm was valued at $200 million post-money in the latest funding round.

Velocity develops infrastructure for stablecoin settlement and payment operations.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Oil Rises Again as Saudi East-West Pipeline Stays Shut
data.description:
Oil climbed for a second day after the Saudi Arabian East-West pipeline remained offline, according to Bloomberg.

The conduit, a workaround for Strait of Hormuz flows, was shut last week after attacks, and Saudi Aramco has not said when it may restart. Tyler Kendall reported on Bloomberg Television.

data.title: AI | Corient’s Daniel Pinto Dismisses Talk of an AI Slowdown
data.description: Talk of an AI slowdown is "more PR than substance" as US technology companies race to compete with one another and with China, according to Bloomberg. Daniel Pinto, EMEA chief executive officer at wealth manager Corient, made the comment in an interview with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on "The Pulse".

data.title: JPMorgan’s Misra Says Bond Selloff May Be Nearing Its End
data.description: Priya Misra, a portfolio manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, said the bond selloff may be nearing an end, but cautioned that several things still need to happen before investors step in, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Standard Chartered-Backed Anchorpoint Financial Launches TAP Programme
data.description:
Anchorpoint Financial, the licensed stablecoin issuer jointly backed by Standard Chartered, HKT and Animoca Brands, said on Tuesday it has launched the Tokenised Money Adoption Programme (TAP), an industry initiative focused on education, research and dialogue around tokenised money in Hong Kong.

PwC also signed a memorandum of understanding with Anchorpoint Financial and became the programme's first strategic partner, according to Ming Pao.

data.title: KKR Private Investment-Grade Deal Volume Doubles to $80 Billion This Year
data.description:
KKR & Co. doubled the amount of private investment-grade financing it structured this year to $80 billion, according to Bloomberg.

The increase reflects growing demand from companies seeking flexible borrowing options.

data.title: Barclays Reaffirms Buy Rating on Strategy, Sets $160 Target Price
data.description: Barclays Bank, which manages $2.3 trillion in assets, reaffirmed its buy rating on Bitcoin treasury company Strategy and set a $160 target price. According to Odaily, Barclays grouped MSTR with fintech giants such as Visa and Mastercard.

data.title: Japan Land Prices Rise For Fifth Straight Year
data.description:
According to Nikkei Asia, Japan's average land price rose for a fifth straight year, with the nationwide overall average up 1.5% in the 12 months to July 1, government data released on Tuesday showed. Commercial land prices climbed 2.9% on demand for shops and hotels, while residential land prices gained 1.0%.

The three largest metropolitan areas of Tokyo, Osaka and Nagoya posted a 4.4% increase, while the rest of the country was flat at 0.4%, widening the gap between urban centers and regional areas. Among major cities outside the three metros, land-price growth slowed to 4.1% from 5.3% a year earlier. Furano in Hokkaido recorded the sharpest rise in residential land at 32.0%, and Hakuba in Nagano prefecture had the steepest increase in commercial land at 35.6%. The Meidi-ya Ginza commercial building site in Tokyo remained Japan's most expensive piece of real estate at 52.5 million yen per square meter for the 21st straight year.
